Tb.bar_b_note: A's smooth terracotta clay body with stuck-on moss decals reads as a toy, and B's fur is closer to the style bar but is broken up by flat yellow coin-like blotches; both boars stand below trainer head height, and A's faint end tips nose-down onto its face.

Tu.bar_b_note: B's after frames do read site-specific (banner torn down, cage opened with captive freed, tent gone and smoke rising, banner fallen in the grass), but A leaves the oxblood banners standing after the win in rows 1, 3 and 5, and both sides share smeared, low-detail ground, a flat untextured cliff wall in row 1, sparse even-scatter trees and no time-of-day grade or atmosphere.

Sv.bar_b_note: The elderly villager has a clear, appealing face, readable eyes and a warm green-brown palette with no oxblood, but the shiny, rounded animated-film face is a step more cartoon than the naturalistic creatures it stands beside, and the full-body view is small and stiff.

Uq.bar_b_note: The blue-and-orange water drake has a strong, tall silhouette that clears the trainer, but its glossy, uniform finish sits below the fur-and-feather bar, its faint mid body hovers over its shadow, and the 'ridden' frame shows no rider at all, so the travel role does not read.

Ny.bar_b_note: The mossy, naturalistic turtle reads well and B's faint end lands cleanly on its shell with its legs up, but A's faint is only a belly slump (not twisted, but not on its back either), the shell sits no higher than the trainer's shoulder, and a dark, low-contrast material keeps it from being the brightest subject.

Ql.bar_b_note: The standing ram matches the Stormcapra style bar, but A's hit react barely moves and its faint frames turn into a twisted, legs-splayed knot, while B's faint mid and faint end lose the head and legs, leaving a white fleece blob with a stretched black horn tube.

Jz.bar_b_note: This is the same water drake as Uq, with the same tall, readable silhouette; A's hit react is only a slight crouch and B's rear-up reads more as a hop than a flinch, and in both sides the faint bodies sit loosely over their shadows on the bare stage.

Zt.bar_b_note: The coiled blue-and-pink sea serpent towers over the trainer and its faint lies flat and grounded, but B's hit react lifts the coils clear of the stage, and the swimming frame is a flat, opaque blue slab with the trainer standing on the surface, with no wake, foam or depth, which sinks the travel read.

top_changes.change: Re-author the hit react and faint poses on every creature rig (Uq, Jz, Zt, Ql, Ny, Tb): a clear backward flinch with the feet planted, and a faint that settles onto its side or back with full body-to-shadow contact, keeping the head and legs intact (Ql B, Tb A).

Bring the Tb boar (and the glossy water drake of Uq/Jz) up to the fur/scale material bar of Stormcapra/Stormursa, replace the clay body and yellow blotches with real fur, and scale the boar and turtle above the 1.80 m trainer.

Trainer-defeat aftermath (Tu): always remove or topple the oxblood banners, add per-site props (freed captive, broken cage, smoke, scattered crates), and give the sites a ground material with real detail, clustered vegetation and a time-of-day light grade instead of smeared flat terrain.
